using Makie

function makeplot(x::AbstractVector, y::AbstractVector, scale::AbstractVector)
    if length(x) != length(y) || length(y) != length(scale)
        throw(ArgumentError("All input vectors must be of equal length."))
    end
    if any(iszero, scale)
        throw(ArgumentError("Scale vector must not contain zero values."))
    end

    fig = Figure(size=(700, 420))
    ax = Axis(fig[1, 1]; title="Scaled", xlabel="Sample", ylabel="Ratio")

    scatter!(ax, x, y ./ scale; color=:orange)

    return fig, ax
end
